🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, with narrow/weak breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Rising volatility and falling equities point to caution, but flat credit and stock-versus-bond ratios do not confirm a decisive regime shift.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is increasing: VXX (1W: +5.69% | 1M: +27.80%) ABOVE TREND. Equities are weak and duration is firmer: SPY (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.09%) BELOW TREND, while TLT (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.19%) ABOVE TREND; the credit ratio is flat (1W: 0.00% | 1M: 0.00%), → flat.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar firmer: UUP (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +2.14%) ABOVE TREND. Treasury duration has a modest bid: TLT (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.19%) ABOVE TREND; yield-curve data are flat (1W: 0.00% | 1M: 0.00%), → flat.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensive and consumer sector breadth is mixed: XLP (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +4.46%) ABOVE TREND and XLY (1W: +0.53% | 1M: +3.03%) ABOVE TREND, while XLK (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -15.69%) is BELOW TREND. XLF is in CORRECTION (1W: -1.68% | 1M: +0.16%); with breadth at 3/11, style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US weakness is broad: SPY (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.09%) BELOW TREND. International ETFs also lag: EEM (1W: -2.71% | 1M: -8.30%) and FXI (1W: -4.41% | 1M: -3.32%) are both BELOW TREND; INDA (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +13.20%) is ABOVE TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative appetite is weak: ARKK (1W: -4.77% | 1M: -17.57%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -25.34%) BELOW TREND. Small caps remain soft: IWM (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -3.56%) BELOW TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity weakness, with copper and precious metals under pressure: CPER (1W: -9.70% | 1M: -17.49%), GLD (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -11.52%), and SLV (1W: -13.60% | 1M: -24.29%) are all BELOW TREND. Natural gas is an exception: UNG (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy ETFs are weak: XLE (1W: -4.59% | 1M: -13.20%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -2.05% | 1M: -17.58%) BELOW TREND. Natural gas is stronger, with UNG (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed weakness: SPY (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.09%) and XLK (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -15.69%) are both BELOW TREND; TLT (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.19%) is ABOVE TREND. Divergence: XLF is in CORRECTION (1W: -1.68% | 1M: +0.16%); broad core-ETF divergence is not established.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Maintain a selective, defensive posture consistent with NEUTRAL conditions and 3/11 breadth; favor monitoring Treasury duration through TLT (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.19%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to weak momentum areas such as XLK (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -15.69%) BELOW TREND, while style leadership remains unclear.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth improves beyond 3/11 and consumer strength persists, monitor XLP (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +4.46%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: If tech weakness continues, monitor XLK (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -15.69%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If the natural-gas advance holds, monitor UNG (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: If industrial-demand weakness persists, monitor CPER (1W: -9.70% | 1M: -17.49%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Price and ratio levels are not supplied in the feed. Monitor whether VXX (1W: +5.69% | 1M: +27.80%) ABOVE TREND continues rising, and whether SPY (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.09%) BELOW TREND stabilizes.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime; breadth is narrow/weak at 3/11 sectors positive. Relative strength is concentrated in XLP (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +4.46%) ABOVE TREND and XLY (1W: +0.53% | 1M: +3.03%) ABOVE TREND, with no clear style leadership. Monitor rising volatility in VXX (1W: +5.69% | 1M: +27.80%) ABOVE TREND against weakness in SPY (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.09%) BELOW TREND.
